defects.finding: Browser decoding alone is not every condition on MediaElementAudioSourceNode output: CORS-cross-origin media must produce graph silence. The proposed local graph remains feasible, and no cross-origin route or universal codec support is promised; the omitted origin condition is a prototype boundary, not a false rejection of live audition.

Carried WCAG source identities use the2023 edition date with the current URL, now serving the2024 Recommendation edition. Applicable keyboard/focus/status criteria are supported; full earlier response custody is unavailable.

defects.scope: SCW method, separate from final source truth
defects.finding: The selected sentence applies format-specific wording to any parser-successful player failure. Its intended C adds a known unsupported-format condition before testing C/C*. That narrows the selected original instead of preserving its scope. Ordinary FI-01 and the final correctly repair the overbroad message using governing media-error evidence. This does not establish full SCW method conformance.

materiality_rule: A concrete consequential factual rule contradicting governing versioned code is material even when the recommended explicit mapping remains sensible. Minor compression, edition and unchosen-path boundaries do not by themselves negate a supported proposal.
